description: This file defines a PHP class named Curl within the namespace Opencart\System\Library\Cart. The class provides methods to set options and send HTTP requests using cURL, encapsulating cURL operations for making HTTP requests within the project.

classes.name: Curl
classes.description: A PHP class that encapsulates cURL functionality for sending HTTP requests, allowing configuration of options and executing requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Curl object with a target URL.

methods.name: setOption
methods.description: Sets a specific cURL option key-value pair for the request.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Executes the cURL request with the specified URL and data, returning the response decoded from JSON or an empty array if the response status is not 200.
